info.name: Colors and Pallettes API
info.description:
CRUD requests for the pallettes and colors MongoDB collections. A color has a pallette: POST create color sends the _id of a pallette in the first collection, and every color payload shows that pallette with populate().

Start the server with `npm run dev`, then run the collection from top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). POST create pallette saves the new _id in {{palletteId}} and POST create color saves {{colorId}}, so the requests after them use those IDs. Every run uses a new pallette name and the last folder deletes that pallette, so the collection can be run again.
